summary: E2E tested the Accounting Firewall Panel (iter 190). Backend: 3/4 pytest assertions PASS (status shape, unbalanced rejection w/ counter increment + recent_rejections, balanced acceptance). Idempotency operations test SKIPPED — /api/operations payload requires supplier/vehicle context (preflight 400 'عمليات الشراء/مرتجع الشراء تتطلب اختيار مورد'). Frontend: ALL 14 required data-testids present, run-demo flow shows 6 demo-log rows including ✅ rejection of unbalanced entry and ✅ 'تم القبول' (acceptance) for balanced entry. After reload, firewall-stat-rejections increased (2→3) and 3 firewall-rejection-row items appear, including newly-created FIREWALL_DEMO_UNBALANCED. Sidebar link '🛡️ جدار حماية المحاسبة' confirmed under 'المالية والمحاسبة'. No blocking issues.

minor.issue: Idempotency on transaction_id cannot be verified via simple JSON payload — endpoint requires supplier/vehicle pre-conditions; firewall logs idempotency_hit only inside business flow. Recommend exposing a thin idempotency probe or accepting workshop-only no-vehicle service ops in tests.

action_items: (Optional) Adjust idempotency probe path or sample payload so /api/operations can be tested without supplier dependency — purely for regression coverage.
(Optional) Tag balanced demo entries with [FIREWALL_DEMO_BALANCED] description so QA can filter demo data from real entries.
critical_code_review_comments: firewall_state is in-memory only — counters/events reset on backend restart. Acceptable for live monitoring panel but document this in UI tooltip; otherwise 'lifetime_rejections=0' after restart may confuse auditors.
routes_firewall._fetch_journal_entries silently returns [] for non-supabase providers — DB_PROVIDER=supabase is currently active so OK, but log a warning if provider unsupported.
Frontend FirewallPanel auto-refresh every 15s is reasonable but ensure interval is cleared on unmount (verified via code inspection — looks OK).
POST /api/firewall/test/log-rejection is a public test endpoint with no auth — consider gating behind ENV flag for production.

success_rate.backend: 75% (3/4, 1 skipped due to ops payload requirements)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test journal entries during pytest run (1 unbalanced rejected, 1 balanced TEST_balanced_iter190 accepted). 1 demo-unbalanced rejection captured in firewall_state log via UI demo button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Firewall panel is live at /accounting/firewall after login. All testids are stable. /api/firewall/status accepts ?workshop_id=finmodule-sync. POST /api/finance/journal-entries REQUIRES workshop_id as query parameter (not just body). To test idempotency end-to-end via /api/operations, prepare seed supplier/vehicle first or call internal helper used by the route.
rca of the issue: No blocking bug found. Idempotency test skip RCA: /api/operations validates business pre-conditions (supplier required for purchase ops) before reaching the idempotency check inside create_operation, so a stub payload returns 400 before idempotency_hit can be recorded. Mitigation: pass a service-type op with vehicleId or use a dedicated test fixture that seeds supplier.
